recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Any future redesign of the moved extensions should be handled in the Extension Pack under a new work-group decision, not as remaining FHIR-7621 core work.
issue_request: FHIR-7621 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested that Condition.dueTo.target and Condition.occurredFollowing.target use the same detail naming as Condition.evidence.detail, noting that dueTo and occurredFollowing were becoming extensions under FHIR-7620.
initial_application: Commit d9e60bf0bbf8924afe37bac0b3187b05d498573c applied #7620/#7621 by moving dueTo and occurredFollowing to standard extensions. The parent Condition spreadsheet had Condition.dueTo.target and Condition.occurredFollowing.target; the post-commit extension spreadsheet had dueTo.detail and occurredFollowing.detail.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current core Condition has Condition.evidence but no Condition.dueTo or Condition.occurredFollowing elements; later R5/R6 refactors represent evidence as CodeableReference and map Condition.evidence.detail to Condition.evidence.reference. The current condition-dueTo and condition-occurredFollowing definitions are maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack as Extension.value[x] extensions, not target/detail subextensions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current core and extension-pack sources already reflect the issue family without a remaining stale target element to rename.
